name: context-plane
description: Scoped, durable agent runtime for the Context Plane POC

scripts.build: npm run build -w @context-plane/contracts && npm run build -w @context-plane/scenario && npm run build -w @context-plane/persistence && npm run build -w @context-plane/core && npm run build -w @context-plane/runner && npm run build -w @context-plane/gateway && npm run build -w @context-plane/e2e && npm run build -w @context-plane/api && npm run build -w @context-plane/mcp && npm run build -w @context-plane/hq
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/agent-sync/*.test.mjs
